topic.readerProblem: A marketer or founder who is leaving Quattr, or avoiding its sales-led route, wants alternatives that fit their reason, with current prices and honest limits, plus a clear view of when Quattr is still the right choice.
topic.connection: AEOeye sells a one-time AI visibility audit (free ChatGPT check, $29 five-engine report); the page places it honestly among daily trackers and sales-led platforms and says where AEOeye is not a substitute.

assessment: The page is based on Quattr's and each alternative's own public pricing and product pages read on 2026-10-03, and says in its first lines that we have not tested any product hands-on. It derives the reasons people leave Quattr only from Quattr's own pages (no published price, an operating-program model with a strategist, a WordPress-only native publishing path, a use-case-dependent trial route) rather than reviewer rumours. It lists six options with entry prices re-read from vendor pages today (Otterly, Peec AI and Nightwatch rendered in a browser for the monthly figures), answers the 'Quattr dashboards' query by comparing Looker-style connectors by tier, corrects the earlier version's stale Profound $99 and Nightwatch $32 plus add-on figures, and explains that Quattr's comparison page puts '$99/month for SMBs' in the Profound column which Profound's own pricing page no longer shows. It ends with when Quattr is still right. It deliberately does not state a Quattr price, rate any product's data quality, or claim hands-on use.

sources.supports: Quattr pricing page is a demo request form with no price or plan (confirmed in raw HTML via curl).

Quattr's comparison page: pricing 'Custom pricing'; 'Starts at $99/month for SMBs' is in the Profound column; WordPress native CMS publishing 'now', more CMS coming soon; Search Console and GA4 joins; Looker Enterprise edition embedded; FAQ listing demo, sandbox, free trial, proof of concept or paid pilot; Quattr claims it replaces multiple tools.

Decide, Optimize, Create, Prove cadence; every customer works with a Strategist (biweekly typical, weekly as an upgrade); prepared work reviewed by the customer; read-only MCP; GIGA agent and Internal Linking AI.

Lite $29/month with 15 prompts on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Copilot, daily tracking, Claude/Gemini/AI Mode as paid add-ons; Standard $189 for 100 prompts including a Looker Studio connector; free trial offered (confirmed in raw HTML).
Rendered in a browser: Starter $95, Pro $245, Advanced $495 a month; 50, 150, 350 prompts; choose 3 models; daily tracking; Looker Studio integration on the Advanced card; Start free trial button.

Rendered in a browser with the Monthly toggle: Starter EUR 99, Professional EUR 199, Agency EUR 499 billed monthly; yearly toggle shows EUR 79/month (EUR 948 billed yearly) for Starter; Starter has 50 AI prompts and 500 keywords; ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Mode and AI Overview; 14-day free trial, no credit card.

Free plan with $25 free credit / 300 credits (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot); Starter $295/month with 3,600 credits, 11 models, on-page and off-page actions, content optimization agent; '1 credit = 1 AI response'; Enterprise includes an executive dashboard with BI tool support (Tableau, Power BI, Looker); page redirects to /plans (confirmed in raw HTML and in a browser).

Brand plans are a free Trial (50 prompts run daily for 7 days on ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) and a custom Enterprise plan (up to 9 answer engines, SSO/SAML and SOC 2); no $99 plan shown (confirmed in raw HTML).
Under 1 in 100 chance ChatGPT or Google's AI repeats the same brand list across runs; ask 60-100 times and average (confirmed in raw HTML).
